newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Esprit Asia shares fall after placement.
newsitem.headline: Esprit Asia shares fall after placement.

text.p: Shares of Esprit Asia Holdings Ltd fell on dilution fears after the company annouced a share placement plan, brokers said on Tuesday.

"Fear of earnings dilution after the placement triggered selling," said Kinson Au, senior analyst at PW Asia Brokerage. "We expect a consolidation after a downward adjustment which narrows the gap between the placement and the trading prices."
The shares fell HK$0.15 or 4.11 percent to HK$3.50 in late morning on volume of 1.78 million shares worth HK$6.31 million.
Esprit Asia had said it planned to issue 180.41 million new shares to its 71.14 percent controlling parent Worldwide Thousand Ltd to raise net proceeds of HK$616 million.
Its parent had also agreed to place 180.41 million existing Esprit shares to institutional investors at HK$3.50 each, representing a 4.1 percent discount to Monday close of HK$3.65.
